extracted.intended_audience: Yale researchers and research administrators (students, post-docs, faculty, academic staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Using Yale-hosted tools and curated channels to discover internal, limited-submission, federal, foundation, and corporate funding opportunities relevant to research projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Opportunities newsletter
rubrics_metrics.description: The Funding Opportunities newsletter is sent every Wednesday by the Office of the Provost. It contains a curated selection of internal funding, limited submissions, and select federal and foundation funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe to receive curated opportunities; contact internal.proposals@yale.edu for more information. To have an announcement posted in the newsletter, fill out the provided request form.

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoReady (Yale InfoReady Review)
rubrics_metrics.description: InfoReady is Yale’s grant management platform for internal and limited submission grants. Funding opportunities are also posted on Yale’s InfoReady Review website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visit the InfoReady Review site to search for funding opportunities in your particular area of interest; use it for internal and limited-submission opportunities managed by Yale.

rubrics_metrics.name: InfoEd SPIN funding opportunities database
rubrics_metrics.description: Yale subscribes to the InfoEd SPIN funding opportunities database. SPIN by InfoEd Global is the world’s largest database of funding opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPIN to search a large, global collection of funding opportunities; it is aimed at students, post-docs, faculty, academic staff, and other research professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal grant opportunities and funded grants database
rubrics_metrics.description: A collection/link to federal grant opportunities and a database of awards maintained by Yale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult this federal opportunities and funded grants database for additional funding leads and examples of awarded grants (link provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: QuantumCT funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: QuantumCT is a joint initiative between Yale University and the University of Connecticut, funded by the National Science Foundation, aimed at advancing Connecticut’s position in quantum technologies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learn more about QuantumCT-specific funding opportunities via the provided QuantumCT link; relevant for researchers working on quantum-related projects in the Connecticut region.
